_why: 검수에서 걸려 다시 만들면 크레딧이 나간다 → 걸리는 유형을 생성 단계에서 미리 막는다. 새 ❌ 유형이 나오면 여기에 한 줄 추가(학습).
flow_video_suffix: Only the characters already in the image; do not add any new characters or animals. The baby penguin keeps exactly the same design for the whole clip: round fluffy gray chick, white belly, big glossy eyes, small red backpack — never a realistic penguin, never black-headed. Signs and screens stay blank, no text or letters anywhere. No fire, no flames. Keep the camera framing close to the image. The main action happens in the first 4 seconds, then the pose holds gently.
flow_image_suffix: Same characters and designs as the reference. Blank signs, no text or letters. Do not draw smell lines, steam lines or motion lines (effects are added later).

by_case.rule: 클립 대신 still(정지 그림+카메라) 기본 — 2화 c05·c08·c12·c16에서 캐릭터 변형·중복 발생
